items.title: DK Shivakumar: 'no double standards' after Bengaluru police detained anti-SIR/CEC protesters
items.summary: Bengaluru police detained and removed a group of anti-SIR/CEC protesters near K.R. Circle on Oct 12 after they gathered without permission to march toward the Karnataka Chief Electoral Officer's office. In a Tuesday press briefing, Karnataka CM D.K. Shivakumar said the right to peaceful protest is fundamental: 'we cannot demand the right to protest in Delhi and deny it in Bengaluru' — he sought a full report on the police action and said any unnecessary force or excess will bring accountability ('accountability will follow'). Karnataka Home Minister Priyank Kharge added Tuesday morning that the police handling would be reviewed and ordered that no peaceful demonstration be disrupted. First tracked Bengaluru-police-action episode with a top-state-level political response.
